chunks: Ahmad ibn Mihrān, from Muḥammad ibn ʿAlī, from Mūsā al-Ṣayqal, from al-Mufaḍḍal ibn ʿUmar, who said:
I was with Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, then Abū Ibrāhīm عليه السلام entered while he was a boy. So he said: “Commend him, and place his affair with those among your companions whom you trust.”

key_terms.أَبُو إِبْرَاهِيمَ: Abū Ibrāhīm, the title of Imām Mūsā al-Kāẓim عليه السلام
key_terms.أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ: Abū ʿAbdillāh, the title of Imām Jaʿfar al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام
key_terms.اسْتَوْصِ: take special care and counsel concerning him

ai.seo_question: How did Imām al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام indicate the position of Abū Ibrāhīm Mūsā عليه السلام to his companions?
ai.summary: This hadith reports an early indication from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام concerning Abū Ibrāhīm عليه السلام while he was still young. It highlights entrusting his affair to reliable companions, reflecting recognition of his future authority and the importance of trusted transmission among the companions.

en.hubeali: Ahmad Bin Mihran, from Muhammad Bin Ali, from Musa Al Sayqal, from Al Mufazzal Bin Umar who said,

‘I was in the presence of Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, and Abu Ibrahim<sup>asws</sup> (7<sup>th</sup> Imam<sup>asws</sup>) came over, and he<sup>asws</sup> was a boy. So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘I<sup>asws</sup> shall be bequeathing to him<sup>asws</sup>, and place his<sup>asws</sup> matter in the presence of the ones you can rely upon from your companions’.
en.sarwar: 4. Ahmad ibn Mihran has narrated from Muhammad ibn Ali from Musa as.-Sayqal from al-Mufaddal ibn ‘Umar who has said the following.

“Once I was in the presence of abu ‘Abdallah (a.s.) that abu Ibrahim came and was a young boy. He (abu ‘Abdallah ) said (to me), “Accept my directive will about him (Musa ibn Ja‘far) and discuss his task (Leadership with Divine Authority) with your reliable companions.” :
